summary: Short kerb at a road junction mouth, no room to stop.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs nearby

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the kerb, but houses 18-22 m away at the start.
drivers.access_and_room: The stretch is the road end where it meets a curved through road at a give-way line; no clear ground beside the lane to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Junction with a curved through road, passing traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this stretch; parked cars sit further along the curved road.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs within 9 m of the kerb
Grade up to about 13% over 22 m
Houses 18 m and 22 m away at the start
sun_shade: Bush canopy over the verge, shade from the west and north.
